row.name: PocketLLM
row.description: 🚀 A powerful Flutter-based AI chat application that lets you run LLMs directly on your mobile device or connect to local model servers. Features offline model execution, Ollama/LLMStudio integration, and a beautiful modern UI. Privacy-focused, cross-platform, and fully open source.
